title: Can you play We Go Back to Black
summary: During this session, the user and Addy navigated playing music on YouTube—initially starting with Amy Winehouse, switching to "The Sailor Song" by Gigi Perez after dealing with an unavailable video link—and adjusted the playback volume to the user's preference. They also attempted to locate and open a local computer science project PDF from the downloads folder, though Addy's web-reading tool was unable to process the local file path while the user was away from their computer. They successfully resolved the media playback and volume adjustments, but left the review and reading of the "Class-11 Project Details" PDF unfinished. Next time, they should pick up by having the user share their screen or paste the PDF text so Addy can read and help analyze the project details.
